brief_title: A Trial Investigating the Efficacy and Safety of Insulin Degludec/Liraglutide Injection in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A 26-Week,Randomised,Open-Label,Multicenter,Active-Controlled,Parallel-Design,Phase III Clinical Trial to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of Insulin Degludec/Liraglutide Injection With XULTOPHY® Once Daily Via Subcutaneous Injection in Chinese Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from baseline in HbA1c after 26 weeks of treatment

brief_summary: This is a randomised, open-label, multicenter, active-controlled, parallel-design, phase III clinical trial. The purpose of this study to compare the efficacy and safety of Insulin Degludec/Liraglutide Injection with XULTOPHY® once daily via subcutaneous injection in Chinese Subjects with Type 2 Diabetes.
